# LaSPUR: Land and Sea Planning Unit Reconcilliation

## Implementasi Pendekatan Multi-layer Dalam Pembangunan Peta Identifikasi Kasus Bertetangga

Dalam proses identifikasi kasus bertetangga (`identify_adjacent()` + `process_adjacent()` + `dissolve_id_pu()`), setiap pasangan poligon bertetangga (`id_pu`) menyimpan 2 baris geometri untuk poligon `RTRW` dan `RZWP3K`. Ketika satu poligon laut `RZWP3K` memiliki luasan besar bersentuhan dengan puluhan/ratusan poligon di darat `RTRW` di sepanjang garis pantai, maka:

1.  Poligon laut yang sama diduplikasi hingga $N$ kali di `idx_serasi_adjacent.gpkg`, `idx_padu_combine.gpkg`, dan `idx_padan.gpkg`.
2.  Modul PADU memanggil `dissolve_id_pu()`, membentuk $N$ buah poligon gabungan `R ∪ Z` yang masing-masing mengekstrak ulang poligon besar yang sama dan skor PADU pasangan pesisir terdistorsi karena luas gabungan didominasi poligon laut.

## Multi-layer Geopackage dan Pembangunan Evaluation Unit Map

Notebook ini mengimplementasikan pendekatan baru dalam proses integrasi tata ruang darat-laut untuk studi kasus Sulawesi Tengah (`Case Study/Sulteng/Data`):

1.  GeoPackage Multi-Layer (`features`, `pairs`, `eval_units`):
    - `features` (*spatial layer*): 1 baris per poligon unik (`id`) (`RXXX` / `ZXXX`) beserta geometri aslinya
    - `pairs` (*non-spatial table*): 1 baris per `id_pu` berisi atribut `id_rtrw`, `id_rzwp3k`, `id_group`, `length`, `idx_serasi`, `fungsi`, `status_penafisan`, `penafisan_layer`, serta skor PADU dan PADAN.
    - `eval_units` (*spatial layer*): 1 poligon *cookie-cutter* per `id_pu` dibangun sebagai unit evaluasi langsung untuk seluruh 6 modul PADU aktif (`KE`, `HS`, `KH`, `RTp`, `SE`, `KI`).
2.  Symmetric Adaptive Cookie-Cutter + Voronoi Partitioning (`eval_units`):
    - Jika $\text{Area}_{\text{big}} > 5 \times \text{Area}_{\text{small}}$ (simetris: berlaku baik laut $\gg$ darat maupun darat $\gg$ laut), hanya sisi yang jauh lebih besar yang dipotong di sekitar garis kontak `shared_line`.
    - Radius jangkauan $X$ dihitung dengan *Equivalent Circular Diameter:* $$X = \max\left(100\text{ m},\; 2\sqrt{\frac{A_{\text{small}}}{\pi}}\right)$$untuk menjaga proporsi luas area evaluasi yang akan digunakan dalam perhitungan PADU \~1:1 dengan poligon kecil.
    - Seluruh segmen `shared_line` yang menempel pada poligon dengan luasan besar yang sama dipartisi dengan `sf::st_voronoi()` sehingga irisan antar-pasangan yang bertetangga saling lepas (*disjoint*), tegak lurus, dan tidak pernah meluber ke depan wilayah tetangganya.

# Step 1: Load libraries, functions, & data

```{r setup-libraries}
#| eval: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

# Load functions and libraries
proj_root <- if (file.exists("R/functions.R")) "." else ".."
source(file.path(proj_root, "R/functions.R"))
source(file.path(proj_root, "R/helpers.R"))
source(file.path(proj_root, "R/adjacent_multilayer.R"))

library(sf)
library(terra)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(purrr)
library(igraph)
library(furrr)
library(future)
library(openxlsx)
library(ggplot2)

sf::sf_use_s2(FALSE)
options(future.globals.maxSize = 16 * 1024^3)
```

```{r assign-data-paths}
#| eval: false

data_dir   <- "D:/OneDrive - CIFOR-ICRAF/ICRAF/Project/Solusi/LaSPUR/Case Study/Sulteng/Data"
output_dir <- "D:/OneDrive - CIFOR-ICRAF/ICRAF/Project/Solusi/LaSPUR/Case Study/Sulteng/Hasil Step 2_v3/"

if (!dir.exists(output_dir)) dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE)

# SERASI Input

acuan_rtrw_path     <- file.path(data_dir, "01_Analisis SERASI/Step 2/tabel_acuan_pola_RTRW_step2.xlsx")

# PADUs Input

lulc_vect_path       <- file.path(data_dir, "02_Analisis PADU-KE/PL2024_Coral_Seagrass_Union.shp")

# PADU-HS

# Legal layer check input
filter_layers <- list(
```

# Step 2: Ekstraksi, penafisan, & pembangunan multi-layer SERASI

```{r run-serasi-multilayer}
#| eval: false

.timing_state$rows <- list()

run_timed_step("SERASI - Load Data", {
  rtrw_vect        <-  load_and_validate_shapefile(rtrw_path)
  rzwp3k_vect      <-  load_and_validate_shapefile(rzwp3k_path)
  admin_vect       <-  load_and_validate_shapefile(admin_path)
  rtrw_prioritas   <-  load_and_validate_table(acuan_rtrw_path)
  rzwp3k_prioritas <-  load_and_validate_table(acuan_rzwp3k_path)
  matriks_serasi   <-  load_validate_matrix_table(matriks_serasi_path, title = "serasi")
})

# Identify adjacent pairs
adj_contacts <- run_timed_step("SERASI - extract_adjacent_contacts", {
  extract_adjacent_contacts(
    rtrw           = rtrw_vect,
    rzwp           = rzwp3k_vect,
    min_area_ha    = 1,
    m_precision    = 1,
    snap_tolerance = 0.5,
    buffer_m       = 100,
    parallel       = TRUE,
    workers        = 4
  )
})

# Merge administration map to adjacent map
adj_enriched <- run_timed_step("SERASI - enrich_adjacent_pairs", {
  enrich_adjacent_pairs(
    adj_obj          = adj_contacts,
    matriks_serasi   = matriks_serasi,
    rtrw_prioritas   = rtrw_prioritas,
    rzwp3k_prioritas = rzwp3k_prioritas,
    admin_sf         = admin_vect,
    admin_col        = admin_col,
    filter_serasi_1  = TRUE
  )
})

# Legal area check and flag
adj_flagged <- run_timed_step("SERASI - Penafisan (flag + filter + export audit)", {
  flagged <- flag_adjacent_pu_filters(
    x               = adj_enriched,
    filter_layers   = filter_layers,
    min_overlap_pct = min_overlap_pct
  )
  print(table(flagged$pairs$status_penafisan))

  serasi_flagged_gpkg <-  file.path(output_dir, "idx_serasi_adjacent_flagged.gpkg")
  serasi_flagged_xlsx <-  file.path(output_dir, "idx_serasi_adjacent_flagged.xlsx")
  write_adjacent_multilayer_gpkg(
    gpkg_path       = serasi_flagged_gpkg,
    features_sf     = flagged$features,
    pairs_df        = flagged$pairs,
    shared_lines_sf = flagged$shared_lines
  )
  openxlsx::write.xlsx(flagged$pairs, serasi_flagged_xlsx)
  flagged
})

# Filter PU within legal area
adj_filtered <- filter_serasi_penafisan(adj_flagged)

# Construct evaluation units as a cookie cutter to calculate PADUs for each PU
adj_ml <- run_timed_step("SERASI - build_eval_units (Cookie-Cutter + Voronoi)", {
  build_eval_units(
    adj_enriched  = adj_filtered,
    ratio_k       = 5,
    min_buffer_m  = 100,
    use_voronoi   = TRUE,
    sample_step_m = 100,
    parallel      = TRUE,
    workers       = 4
  )
})

# Write result
serasi_ml_gpkg <- file.path(output_dir, "idx_serasi_adjacent_multilayer.gpkg")
serasi_ml_xlsx <- file.path(output_dir, "idx_serasi_adjacent.xlsx")

run_timed_step("SERASI - Export Multi-Layer GPKG & XLSX", {
  write_adjacent_multilayer_gpkg(
    gpkg_path     = serasi_ml_gpkg,
    features_sf   = adj_ml$features,
    pairs_df      = adj_ml$pairs,
    eval_units_sf = adj_ml$eval_units
  )
  openxlsx::write.xlsx(adj_ml$pairs, serasi_ml_xlsx)
})

save_timing_log(output_dir)
sf::st_layers(serasi_ml_gpkg)
```

# Step 3: Hitung ringkasan kasus bertetangga

```{r diagnostics-and-viz}
#| eval: false

ml <- read_adjacent_multilayer_gpkg(serasi_ml_gpkg)

cat(sprintf("Unique features (layers 'features') : %d poligon\n", nrow(ml$features)))
cat(sprintf("Total pairs (layers 'pairs')        : %d pasangan\n", nrow(ml$pairs)))
cat(sprintf("Eval units (layers 'eval_units')    : %d cookie-cutter\n", nrow(ml$eval_units)))
cat(sprintf("Ukuran GPKG multi-layer             : %.2f MB\n", file.info(serasi_ml_gpkg)$size / 1024^2))

# Summarize
print(table(ml$pairs$clipped_side))
summary(ml$pairs[, c("area_ha_rtrw", "area_ha_rzwp3k", "clip_radius_m", "area_eval_ha")])

# Summary visualisation
top_group <- ml$pairs %>%
  dplyr::count(id_group, sort = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::slice(1) %>%
  dplyr::pull(id_group)

grp_pairs <- ml$pairs %>% dplyr::filter(id_group == top_group)
grp_eval  <- ml$eval_units %>% dplyr::filter(id_group == top_group)
grp_feats <- ml$features %>%
  dplyr::filter(id %in% unique(c(grp_pairs$id_rtrw, grp_pairs$id_rzwp3k)))

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = grp_feats, aes(fill = source), alpha = 0.15, color = "#475569", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_sf(data = grp_eval, aes(color = factor(id_pu)), fill = NA, linewidth = 0.9) +
  labs(
    title = sprintf("id_group = %d (%d pasangan bertetangga)", top_group, nrow(grp_pairs)),
    subtitle = "Garis berwarna = eval_units terpartisi Voronoi; arsiran = features unik asli",
    fill = "Sumber Layer", color = "id_pu"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

# Step 4: Perhitungan indeks PADU & PADAN

```{r run-padu-on-eval-units}
#| eval: false

ml <- read_adjacent_multilayer_gpkg(serasi_ml_gpkg)
eval_pu <- ml$eval_units

# Calculate PADU-KH
idx_padu_kh <- run_timed_step("PADU-KH", {
  target_crs <- sf::st_crs(eval_pu)
  load_hab_utm <- function(path) {
    v <- load_and_validate_shapefile(path)
    if (sf::st_crs(v) != target_crs) {
      v <- sf::st_transform(v, target_crs)
    }
    sf::st_sf(geometry = sf::st_geometry(v), crs = target_crs)
  }
  coral_vect    <- load_hab_utm(coral_vect_path)
  seagrass_vect <- load_hab_utm(seagrass_vect_path)
  mangrove_vect <- load_hab_utm(mangrove_vect_path)
  coastal_habitat <- dplyr::bind_rows(coral_vect, seagrass_vect, mangrove_vect) %>%
    sf::st_make_valid() %>%
    sf::st_combine() %>%
    sf::st_make_valid() %>%
    sf::st_as_sf()

  idx_padu_kh_map <-  .run_with_parallel_fallback(
    "PADU-KH",
    function() calculate_overlay_pct(pu = eval_pu, overlay_area = coastal_habitat, title = "coastal_habitat", parallel = TRUE,  workers = 4),
    function() calculate_overlay_pct(pu = eval_pu, overlay_area = coastal_habitat, title = "coastal_habitat", parallel = FALSE)
  ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(idx_padu_kh = coastal_habitat_pct / 100)
  tibble::as_tibble(sf::st_drop_geometry(idx_padu_kh_map)) %>%
    dplyr::select(id_pu, idx_padu_kh)
})

# Calculate PADU-HS
idx_padu_hs <- run_timed_step("PADU-HS", {
  river_vect <- load_and_validate_shapefile(river_vect_path)
  tss_rast   <- load_and_validate_raster(tss_rast_path)
  padu_hs <-  calculate_padu_hs(
    idx_serasi_map     = eval_pu,
    river_vect         = river_vect,
    tss_rast           = tss_rast,
    buffer_radius      = buffer_radius_hs,
    tss_good_threshold = 20
  )
  padu_hs$idx_padu_hs %>% dplyr::select(id_pu, idx_padu_hs)
})

# Calculate PADU-RTp
idx_padu_rtp <- run_timed_step("PADU-RTp", {
  industry_euc_dist  <- load_and_validate_raster(industry_euc_dist_path)
  pelayaran_euc_dist <- load_and_validate_raster(pelayaran_euc_dist_path)
  popdens_rast       <- load_and_validate_raster(popdens_map_path)
  padu_rtp <-  calculate_padu_rtp(
    idx_serasi_map     = eval_pu,
    industry_euc_dist  = industry_euc_dist,
    pelayaran_euc_dist = pelayaran_euc_dist,
    popdens_rast       = popdens_rast
  )
  padu_rtp$idx_padu_rtp %>% dplyr::select(id_pu, idx_padu_rtp)
})

# Calculate PADU-SE
idx_padu_se <- run_timed_step("PADU-SE", {
  facilities <- list(
    build_facility_layer("Rumah Sakit", rs_euc_dist_path,      fac_type = "raster", pu = eval_pu, max_dist = 5000),
    build_facility_layer("Pelabuhan",     pelabuhan_euc_dist_path, fac_type = "raster", pu = eval_pu, max_dist = 5000),
    build_facility_layer("Pasar",       pasar_euc_dist_path,   fac_type = "raster", pu = eval_pu, max_dist = 5000),
    build_facility_layer("Jalan",       jalan_euc_dist_path,   fac_type = "raster", pu = eval_pu, max_dist = 5000)
  )
  padu_se <-  calculate_padu_se(
    idx_serasi_map     = eval_pu,
    facilities         = facilities,
    id_col             = "id_pu",
    keep_intermediates = TRUE
  )
  padu_se$idx_padu_se %>% dplyr::select(id_pu, idx_padu_se)
})

# Calculate PADU-KI
idx_padu_ki <- run_timed_step("PADU-KI", {
  disaster_risk_vect <- load_and_validate_shapefile(disaster_risk_path) %>% sf::st_make_valid()
  padu_ki <-  .run_with_parallel_fallback(
    "PADU-KI",
    function() calculate_padu_ki(idx_serasi_map = eval_pu, disaster_risk_vect = disaster_risk_vect, value_col = "Kerawanan", parallel = TRUE,  workers = 4),
    function() calculate_padu_ki(idx_serasi_map = eval_pu, disaster_risk_vect = disaster_risk_vect, value_col = "Kerawanan", parallel = FALSE)
  )
  padu_ki$idx_padu_ki %>% dplyr::select(id_pu, idx_padu_ki)
})

# Calculate PADU-KE
idx_padu_ke <- run_timed_step("PADU-KE", {
  lulc_vect       <- load_and_validate_shapefile(lulc_vect_path)
  lulc_ref        <- lulc_vect %>%
    sf::st_drop_geometry() %>%
    dplyr::select(ID = !!rlang::sym(lulc_id_col), LC = !!rlang::sym(lulc_class_col)) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(ID, LC) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(ID)
  matriks_padu_ke <- load_validate_matrix_table(matriks_padu_ke_path, title = "padu_ke")

  lulc_adjacencies <- .run_with_parallel_fallback(
    "PADU-KE",
    function() calculate_lulc_adjacency(lulc_vect, eval_pu, id_col = "id_pu", class_col = lulc_id_col, parallel = TRUE,  workers = 4),
    function() calculate_lulc_adjacency(lulc_vect, eval_pu, id_col = "id_pu", class_col = lulc_id_col, parallel = FALSE)
  )
  padu_ke <-  calculate_padu_ke(
    matriks_padu_ke  = matriks_padu_ke,
    lulc_ref         = lulc_ref,
    lulc_adjacencies = lulc_adjacencies,
    idx_serasi_map   = eval_pu,
    normalize        = TRUE
  )
  padu_ke$idx_padu_ke %>% dplyr::select(id_pu, idx_padu_ke)
})

save_timing_log(output_dir)
```

## Step 4.1. Perhitungan indeks PADU kombinasi & indeks PADAN

```{r run-padu-combine-and-padan}
#| eval: false

run_timed_step("PADU-Kombinasi & PADAN", {
  padu_idx_weight <-  if (is.null(padu_idx_weight_path)) NULL else load_and_validate_table(padu_idx_weight_path)
  padu_list <- list(
    idx_padu_ke, idx_padu_hs, idx_padu_kh,
    idx_padu_rtp, idx_padu_se, idx_padu_ki
  )

  # Calculate composite value of PADU
  idx_padu_eval <-  calculate_padu_index(
    padu_list       = padu_list,
    idx_padu_map    = eval_pu,
    padu_idx_weight = padu_idx_weight
  )

  alpha <-  0.5
  idx_padan_eval <-  idx_padu_eval %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      idx_padan = (alpha * idx_serasi) + ((1 - alpha) * idx_padu_final)
    )

  # Merge PADU & PADAN index to map
  score_cols <- setdiff(names(sf::st_drop_geometry(idx_padan_eval)), names(ml$pairs))
  score_tbl  <- sf::st_drop_geometry(idx_padan_eval) %>%
    dplyr::select(id_pu, dplyr::all_of(score_cols))

  pairs_padan <-  ml$pairs %>%
    dplyr::left_join(score_tbl, by = "id_pu")

  padan_ml_gpkg <-  file.path(output_dir, "idx_padan_multilayer.gpkg")
  padan_ml_xlsx <-  file.path(output_dir, "idx_padan.xlsx")

  write_adjacent_multilayer_gpkg(
    gpkg_path     = padan_ml_gpkg,
    features_sf   = ml$features,
    pairs_df      = pairs_padan,
    eval_units_sf = idx_padan_eval
  )
  openxlsx::write.xlsx(pairs_padan, padan_ml_xlsx)
})

timing_summary <- save_timing_log(output_dir)
print(timing_summary)

sf::st_layers(padan_ml_gpkg)
head(pairs_padan[, c("id_pu", "id_rtrw", "id_rzwp3k", "clipped_side", "clip_radius_m",
                     "idx_serasi", "idx_padu_final", "idx_padan")])
```
